ko.title: 일하기엔 아프고 CMS 기준엔 못 미치는가: 메디케이드 면제 조항을 둘러싼 주 정부들의 혼란

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem
segments.tr: ## 새로운 규칙, 오래된 문제

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.
segments.tr: 메디케이드 근로 요건은 더 이상 가상의 정책 토론이 아닙니다. 이는 주 정부 기관들이 제한된 지침과 더 부족한 시간 속에서 반드시 시행해야 하는 행정적 현실이 되고 있습니다.

segments.src: At the center of the current confusion is a seemingly narrow question with enormous consequences for millions of low-income Americans: what actually counts as being "too sick to work"?
segments.tr: 현재 혼란의 중심에는 수백만 명의 저소득층 미국인들에게 엄청난 결과를 초래할 겉보기엔 좁아 보이는 질문이 있습니다. 바로 "일하기에 너무 아프다"는 것의 실제 기준은 무엇인가 하는 점입니다.

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.
segments.tr: 수년간, 근로 요건을 시험하고자 했던 주 정부들은 의학적 진단서(만성 질환, 정신 건강 상태, 장애 판정)만 있으면 누구나 의무적인 근로 시간 보고 대상에서 면제될 수 있을 것으로 가정했습니다.

segments.src: Federal guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has complicated that assumption, signaling that a diagnosis alone may not automatically satisfy the "medically frail" or "unable to work" exemption categories written into the new rules.
segments.tr: 미국 메디케어 및 메디케이드 서비스 센터(CMS)의 연방 지침은 그러한 가정을 복잡하게 만들었으며, 진단만으로는 새로운 규정에 명시된 "의학적으로 허약함" 또는 "일할 수 없음" 면제 범위를 자동으로 충족하지 못할 수 있음을 시사했습니다.

segments.src: Instead, states may need to evaluate functional capacity, severity, and documentation in ways that go well beyond a doctor's note.
segments.tr: 대신 주 정부들은 의사의 소견서를 훨씬 넘어선 기능적 능력, 심각성, 그리고 증명 자료를 평가해야 할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## 왜 이러한 구분이 중요한가

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: "진단받은 상태"와 "면제받을 만큼 장애가 있는 상태" 사이의 현실적인 간극은 바로 실질적인 영향이 미치는 지점입니다.

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
segments.tr: 심각하지만 발작적으로 나타나는 질환(특정 자가면역 질환, 반복되는 정신 건강 위기, 만성 통증 장애)을 관리하는 사람은 고정된 일정에 맞춰 안정적으로 직장을 유지하지 못할 수 있지만, 공식적인 면제를 위한 엄격한 임상적 임계값은 충족하지 못할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: State Medicaid agencies, which already run on tight budgets and understaffed eligibility offices, are now being asked to build verification systems that can make these fine-grained distinctions consistently and fairly, often on compressed timelines.
segments.tr: 이미 빠듯한 예산과 인력이 부족한 자격 심사 사무소로 운영되는 주 메디케이드 기관들은 이제 압축된 일정 속에서도 이러한 미세한 차이를 일관되고 공정하게 만들어낼 수 있는 검증 시스템을 구축할 것을 요구받고 있습니다.

segments.src: Advocates for low-income patients warn that ambiguity in the standard risks two failure modes at once: exemptions denied to people who genuinely cannot maintain steady employment, and inconsistent application from state to state that leaves similarly situated patients with very different outcomes depending on where they live.
segments.tr: 저소득층 환자들을 대변하는 이들은 기준의 모호성이 한 번에 두 가지 실패 모드를 초래할 위험이 있다고 경고합니다. 즉, 진정으로 안정적인 고용을 유지할 수 없는 이들에게 면제가 거부되는 것과, 주마다 일관되지 않은 적용으로 인해 거주지에 따라 처한 상황이 비슷한 환자들이 매우 다른 결과를 얻게 되는 것입니다.

segments.src: Supporters of work requirements counter that clearer, stricter documentation standards are necessary to prevent misuse of exemptions and to ensure the policy achieves its intended goal of encouraging workforce participation among able-bodied adults.
segments.tr: 근로 요건 지지자들은 면제 남용을 방지하고 정책이 신체 건강한 성인들의 노동 시장 참여를 장려하려는 본래의 목적을 달성하도록 보장하기 위해 더 명확하고 엄격한 증명 기준이 필요하다고 반박합니다.

segments.src: ## States Push Back in Court
segments.tr: ## 법정으로 향하는 주 정부들

segments.src: The disagreement has moved beyond policy memos and into the courtroom.
segments.tr: 이러한 이견은 정책 메모를 넘어 법정으로 이어졌습니다.

segments.src: A coalition of roughly two dozen states has filed suit against the federal government, arguing that the exemption guidance is unclear, procedurally flawed, or imposes burdens that federal law never intended for state agencies to carry.
segments.tr: 약 20여 개 주 정부 연합은 연방 정부를 상대로 소송을 제기했으며, 면제 지침이 불명확하고 절차상 결함이 있으며, 연방 법이 주 정부 기관에 지우도록 의도한 적 없는 부담을 부과하고 있다고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: The states argue they are being asked to build compliance infrastructure — verification portals, appeals processes, medical review boards — without adequate funding, timeline, or legal clarity on what "sufficient" documentation actually looks like.
segments.tr: 주 정부들은 "충분한" 증명이 실제로 어떤 모습인지에 대한 적절한 예산, 일정, 법적 명확성 없이 검증 포털, 이소 절차, 의료 심사위원회 등 규정 준수 인프라를 구축하라는 요구를 받고 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: The federal government, for its part, maintains that the standards are intended to preserve the integrity of a program designed to serve the most vulnerable, while still requiring meaningful proof for exemptions rather than accepting self-attestation or a single diagnosis code.
segments.tr: 연방 정부는 자기 증명이나 단일 진단 코드를 받아들이는 대신 면제에 대한 의미 있는 증거를 요구하면서도, 가장 취약한 계층을 돕기 위해 설계된 프로그램의 무결성을 유지하기 위한 기준이라고 주장합니다.

segments.src: That tension — between administrative rigor and access for people with genuine, hard-to-quantify limitations — is likely to be litigated for months before a clear national standard emerges.
segments.tr: 행정적 엄격성과 진정하고 수치화하기 어려운 한계를 가진 사람들을 위한 접근성 사이의 이러한 긴장은 명확한 국가적 표준이 나타나기 전까지 몇 달 동안 소송이 진행될 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Enrollees Right Now
segments.tr: ## 가입자들에게 이것이 의미하는 바

segments.src: For Medicaid enrollees living with chronic or fluctuating health conditions, the immediate advice from patient advocacy groups is consistent: keep thorough medical records, including notes on how a condition affects daily functioning and work capacity, not just the diagnosis itself.
segments.tr: 만성적이거나 변동이 심한 건강 상태를 안고 살아가는 메디케이드 가입자들에게 환자 단체들이 전하는 즉각적인 조언은 일관적입니다. 즉, 진단명 그 자체뿐만 아니라 질환이 일상 기능과 근로 능력에 미치는 영향에 대한 기록을 포함하여 철저한 의료 기록을 유지하라는 것입니다.

segments.src: Functional documentation — statements from treating physicians about limitations, frequency of flare-ups, or inability to sustain regular hours — may carry more weight under the new standards than a diagnosis alone.
segments.tr: 치료 의사의 한계에 대한 진술, 증상 악화 빈도, 또는 정규 시간을 유지할 수 없는 능력 등에 관한 기능적 증명 자료는 새로운 기준 하에서 단순한 진단보다 더 큰 무게를 지닐 수 있습니다.

segments.src: State Medicaid websites and enrollment hotlines remain the most reliable source for current, state-specific exemption criteria, since implementation timelines and documentation requirements differ significantly depending on where the litigation and rulemaking process currently stands.
segments.tr: 소송과 규칙 제정 과정이 현재 어디에 위치해 있는지에 따라 이행 일정과 증명 요구 사항이 크게 다르기 때문에, 주 메디케이드 웹사이트와 등록 핫라인은 현재의 주별 면제 기준을 파악할 수 있는 가장 신뢰할 수 있는 출처로 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: Because this is an evolving legal and administrative situation, enrollees and providers should treat any specific requirement as subject to change until courts and CMS finalize guidance.
segments.tr: 이는 진화하는 법적 및 행정적 상황이므로, 가입자와 의료 제공자는 법원과 CMS가 지침을 최종 확정할 때까지 모든 구체적인 요구 사항이 변경될 수 있는 것으로 취급해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: This dispute is really about who bears the burden of proof in a safety-net program undergoing structural change.
segments.tr: 이 분쟁은 실제로 구조적 변화를 겪고 있는 사회안전망 프로그램에서 입증 책임이 누구에게 있는가에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: As work requirements roll out nationally, the exemption question will likely serve as an early test case for how flexible — or how rigid — the new system becomes in practice.
segments.tr: 근로 요건이 전국적으로 시행됨에 따라, 면제에 관한 질문은 새로운 시스템이 실제로 얼마나 유연해질지 또는 얼마나 엄격해질지를 가늠하는 초기 시험대 역할을 할 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: Whatever the courts and CMS ultimately decide, the outcome will shape not just paperwork, but whether people with real, if hard-to-categorize, health limitations retain access to coverage they depend on.
segments.tr: 법원과 CMS가 최종적으로 무엇을 결정하든, 그 결과는 단순히 서류 작업뿐만 아니라 분류하기 어렵지만 실제적인 건강상 한계를 가진 사람들이 의존하는 보장에 대한 접근성을 유지할 수 있을지 여부를 결정짓게 될 것입니다.

zh.title: 病得无法工作，却未达 CMS 豁免标准：各州在医疗补助计划豁免问题上的博弈内幕

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem
segments.tr: ## 新规则，老问题

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.
segments.tr: 医疗补助计划（Medicaid）的工作要求已不再是假设性的政策辩论，而是正在成为各州机构必须实施的行政现实，而他们往往面临着有限的指导和更少的时间。

segments.src: At the center of the current confusion is a seemingly narrow question with enormous consequences for millions of low-income Americans: what actually counts as being "too sick to work"?
segments.tr: 当前混乱的核心是一个看似狭隘、却对数百万低收入美国人产生巨大影响的问题：究竟什么才算“病得无法工作”？

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.
segments.tr: 多年来，希望测试工作要求的各州一直认为，有记录的医学诊断——慢性病、精神健康状况、残疾认定——就足以豁免某人的强制性工作时间申报。

segments.src: Federal guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has complicated that assumption, signaling that a diagnosis alone may not automatically satisfy the "medically frail" or "unable to work" exemption categories written into the new rules.
segments.tr: 然而，来自联邦医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）的联邦指南使这一假设变得复杂，表明单凭诊断可能无法自动满足新规则中写入的“身体虚弱”或“无法工作”的豁免类别。

segments.src: Instead, states may need to evaluate functional capacity, severity, and documentation in ways that go well beyond a doctor's note.
segments.tr: 相反，各州可能需要以远超医生证明的方式，来评估功能能力、严重程度和证明文件。

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么这种区别很重要

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: “确诊”与“残疾到符合豁免条件”之间的实际差距，正是现实世界产生影响的地方。

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
segments.tr: 患有严重但呈发作性疾病（如某些自身免疫性疾病、反复发作的精神健康危机、慢性疼痛障碍）的人，可能无法在固定的时间表上稳定地保住工作，但可能无法达到正式豁免的严格临床门槛。

segments.src: State Medicaid agencies, which already run on tight budgets and understaffed eligibility offices, are now being asked to build verification systems that can make these fine-grained distinctions consistently and fairly, often on compressed timelines.
segments.tr: 各州医疗补助机构本就预算紧张、资格审查办公室人手不足，现在却被要求建立验证系统，以便能够持续、公平地做出这些细微的区分，而且通常是在紧迫的时间表内。

segments.src: Advocates for low-income patients warn that ambiguity in the standard risks two failure modes at once: exemptions denied to people who genuinely cannot maintain steady employment, and inconsistent application from state to state that leaves similarly situated patients with very different outcomes depending on where they live.
segments.tr: 低收入患者的倡导者警告说，标准中的模糊性有同时导致两种失败模式的风险：对真正无法维持稳定就业的人拒绝豁免，以及各州之间执行不一致，导致处境相似的患者因居住地不同而面临截然不同的结果。

segments.src: Supporters of work requirements counter that clearer, stricter documentation standards are necessary to prevent misuse of exemptions and to ensure the policy achieves its intended goal of encouraging workforce participation among able-bodied adults.
segments.tr: 工作要求的支持者则反驳说，更清晰、更严格的证明文件标准是必要的，这可以防止滥用豁免，并确保该政策实现其既定目标，即鼓励有劳动能力的成年人参与就业。

segments.src: ## States Push Back in Court
segments.tr: ## 各州在法庭上发起反击

segments.src: The disagreement has moved beyond policy memos and into the courtroom.
segments.tr: 这一分歧已经超出了政策备忘录的范畴，进入了法庭。

segments.src: A coalition of roughly two dozen states has filed suit against the federal government, arguing that the exemption guidance is unclear, procedurally flawed, or imposes burdens that federal law never intended for state agencies to carry.
segments.tr: 由大约二十个州组成的联盟已对联邦政府提起诉讼，指责豁免指南不明确、程序上有缺陷，或者强加了联邦法律从未意图让州机构承担的负担。

segments.src: The states argue they are being asked to build compliance infrastructure — verification portals, appeals processes, medical review boards — without adequate funding, timeline, or legal clarity on what "sufficient" documentation actually looks like.
segments.tr: 各州辩称，他们被要求建立合规基础设施——验证门户、申诉程序、医疗审查委员会——但却没有足够的资金、时间表，在什么是“充分的”证明文件方面也缺乏法律明确性。

segments.src: The federal government, for its part, maintains that the standards are intended to preserve the integrity of a program designed to serve the most vulnerable, while still requiring meaningful proof for exemptions rather than accepting self-attestation or a single diagnosis code.
segments.tr: 联邦政府则坚持认为，这些标准旨在维护旨在服务最弱势群体的计划的完整性，同时仍要求对豁免提供有意义的证明，而不是接受自我证明或单一的诊断代码。

segments.src: That tension — between administrative rigor and access for people with genuine, hard-to-quantify limitations — is likely to be litigated for months before a clear national standard emerges.
segments.tr: 这种紧张关系——在行政严谨性与为具有真实、难以量化的局限性的人群提供准入之间——可能会在出现明确的国家标准之前诉讼数月。

segments.src: ## What This Means for Enrollees Right Now
segments.tr: ## 这对目前的参保人意味着什么

segments.src: For Medicaid enrollees living with chronic or fluctuating health conditions, the immediate advice from patient advocacy groups is consistent: keep thorough medical records, including notes on how a condition affects daily functioning and work capacity, not just the diagnosis itself.
segments.tr: 对于患有慢性或波动性健康状况的医疗补助计划参保人，患者倡导团体给出的即时建议是一致的：保留详尽的医疗记录，包括关于病情如何影响日常功能和工作能力的记录，而不仅仅是诊断本身。

segments.src: Functional documentation — statements from treating physicians about limitations, frequency of flare-ups, or inability to sustain regular hours — may carry more weight under the new standards than a diagnosis alone.
segments.tr: 在新的标准下，功能性证明文件——主治医生关于局限性、发作频率或无法维持正常工作时间的陈述——可能比单纯的诊断具有更大的分量。

segments.src: State Medicaid websites and enrollment hotlines remain the most reliable source for current, state-specific exemption criteria, since implementation timelines and documentation requirements differ significantly depending on where the litigation and rulemaking process currently stands.
segments.tr: 各州医疗补助计划网站和登记热线仍然是获取当前、特定州豁免标准最可靠的来源，因为实施时间表和证明文件要求因诉讼和制定规则进程的当前所处阶段而有很大差异。

segments.src: Because this is an evolving legal and administrative situation, enrollees and providers should treat any specific requirement as subject to change until courts and CMS finalize guidance.
segments.tr: 由于这是一个不断发展的法律和行政局势，参保人和医疗服务提供者应将任何具体要求视为可能会发生变化，直到法院和 CMS 敲定最终指南。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更宏观的图景

segments.src: This dispute is really about who bears the burden of proof in a safety-net program undergoing structural change.
segments.tr: 这场争端实际上是关于在经历结构性变革的安全网计划中，谁来承担举证责任。

segments.src: As work requirements roll out nationally, the exemption question will likely serve as an early test case for how flexible — or how rigid — the new system becomes in practice.
segments.tr: 随着工作要求在全国范围内推行，豁免问题可能会成为一个早期测试案例，检验新系统在实践中会变得多么灵活——或者多么僵化。

segments.src: Whatever the courts and CMS ultimately decide, the outcome will shape not just paperwork, but whether people with real, if hard-to-categorize, health limitations retain access to coverage they depend on.
segments.tr: 无论法院和 CMS 最终做出何种决定，其结果不仅会塑造文书工作，还会决定那些具有真实但难以分类的健康局限性的人，是否能够继续获得他们所依赖的保险覆盖。

hi.title: काम से छुट्टी लेने के लिए पर्याप्त बीमार, लेकिन CMS के लिए नहीं: मेडिकेड छूट को लेकर राज्यों की भागदौड़ के अंदर की बात

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem
segments.tr: ## एक नया नियम, एक पुरानी समस्या

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.
segments.tr: मेडिकेड कार्य आवश्यकताएं अब कोई काल्पनिक नीतिगत बहस नहीं रह गई हैं — वे एक प्रशासनिक वास्तविकता बन रही हैं जिसे राज्य एजेंसियों को लागू करना होगा, अक्सर सीमित मार्गदर्शन और उससे भी कम समय के साथ।

segments.src: At the center of the current confusion is a seemingly narrow question with enormous consequences for millions of low-income Americans: what actually counts as being "too sick to work"?
segments.tr: वर्तमान भ्रम के केंद्र में एक प्रतीत होता है कि संकीर्ण प्रश्न है जिसके लाखों कम आय वाले अमेरिकियों के लिए भारी परिणाम हैं: वास्तव में "काम करने के लिए बहुत बीमार" होने की गिनती क्या है?

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.
segments.tr: वर्षों से, जो राज्य कार्य आवश्यकताओं का परीक्षण करना चाहते थे, उन्होंने मान लिया था कि एक प्रलेखित चिकित्सा निदान — एक पुरानी बीमारी, मानसिक स्वास्थ्य स्थिति, विकलांगता का निर्धारण — किसी को अनिवार्य कार्य-घंटे रिपोर्टिंग से छूट देने के लिए पर्याप्त होगा।

segments.src: Federal guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has complicated that assumption, signaling that a diagnosis alone may not automatically satisfy the "medically frail" or "unable to work" exemption categories written into the new rules.
segments.tr: सेंटर्स फॉर मेडिकेयर एंड मेडिकेड सर्विसेज (CMS) के संघीय मार्गदर्शन ने उस धारणा को जटिल बना दिया है, यह संकेत देते हुए कि केवल एक निदान स्वचालित रूप से नए नियमों में लिखे गए "चिकित्सकीय रूप से कमजोर" या "काम करने में असमर्थ" छूट श्रेणियों को पूरा नहीं कर सकता है।

segments.src: Instead, states may need to evaluate functional capacity, severity, and documentation in ways that go well beyond a doctor's note.
segments.tr: इसके बजाय, राज्यों को कार्यात्मक क्षमता, गंभीरता और प्रलेखन का मूल्यांकन उन तरीकों से करने की आवश्यकता हो सकती है जो डॉक्टर के नोट से कहीं आगे जाते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## यह अंतर क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: "निदान" और "छूट पाने के लिए पर्याप्त विकलांग" के बीच का व्यावहारिक अंतर वह जगह है जहां वास्तविक दुनिया का प्रभाव पड़ता है।

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
segments.tr: एक गंभीर लेकिन प्रासंगिक बीमारी का प्रबंधन करने वाला व्यक्ति — कुछ ऑटोइम्यून स्थितियां, आवर्ती मानसिक स्वास्थ्य संकट, पुरानी दर्द विकार — एक निश्चित समय पर नौकरी को मज़बूती से बनाए रखने में असमर्थ हो सकता है, फिर भी औपचारिक छूट के लिए एक सख्त नैदानिक सीमा को पूरा नहीं कर सकता है।

segments.src: State Medicaid agencies, which already run on tight budgets and understaffed eligibility offices, are now being asked to build verification systems that can make these fine-grained distinctions consistently and fairly, often on compressed timelines.
segments.tr: राज्य मेडिकेड एजेंसियां, जो पहले से ही तंग बजट और कम कर्मचारियों वाले पात्रता कार्यालयों के तहत चल रही हैं, अब उनसे ऐसी सत्यापन प्रणालियां बनाने के लिए कहा जा रहा है जो इन सूक्ष्म अंतरों को लगातार और निष्पक्ष रूप से बना सकें, अक्सर संकुचित समयसीमा पर।

segments.src: Advocates for low-income patients warn that ambiguity in the standard risks two failure modes at once: exemptions denied to people who genuinely cannot maintain steady employment, and inconsistent application from state to state that leaves similarly situated patients with very different outcomes depending on where they live.
segments.tr: कम आय वाले रोगियों के समर्थकों ने चेतावनी दी है कि मानक में अस्पष्टता एक साथ दो विफलता मोड का जोखिम उठाती है: उन लोगों को छूट से इनकार किया जाना जो वास्तव में स्थिर रोजगार बनाए नहीं रख सकते हैं, और राज्य-दर-राज्य असंगत अनुप्रयोग जो समान रूप से स्थित रोगियों को उनके रहने के स्थान के आधार पर बहुत अलग परिणाम देता है।

segments.src: Supporters of work requirements counter that clearer, stricter documentation standards are necessary to prevent misuse of exemptions and to ensure the policy achieves its intended goal of encouraging workforce participation among able-bodied adults.
segments.tr: कार्य आवश्यकताओं के समर्थकों का तर्क है कि छूट के दुरुपयोग को रोकने और यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि नीति सक्षम वयस्कों के बीच कार्यबल भागीदारी को प्रोत्साहित करने के अपने इच्छित लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करती है, स्पष्ट, सख्त प्रलेखन मानकों की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: ## States Push Back in Court
segments.tr: ## राज्यों ने अदालत में विरोध किया

segments.src: The disagreement has moved beyond policy memos and into the courtroom.
segments.tr: असहमति नीति ज्ञापनों से आगे बढ़कर अदालत के कमरे में पहुंच गई है।

segments.src: A coalition of roughly two dozen states has filed suit against the federal government, arguing that the exemption guidance is unclear, procedurally flawed, or imposes burdens that federal law never intended for state agencies to carry.
segments.tr: लगभग दो दर्जन राज्यों के एक गठबंधन ने संघीय सरकार के खिलाफ मुकदमा दायर किया है, यह तर्क देते हुए कि छूट मार्गदर्शन अस्पष्ट है, प्रक्रियात्मक रूप से त्रुटिपूर्ण है, या ऐसे बोझ डालता है जो संघीय कानून ने कभी राज्य एजेंसियों के लिए नहीं सोचा था।

segments.src: The states argue they are being asked to build compliance infrastructure — verification portals, appeals processes, medical review boards — without adequate funding, timeline, or legal clarity on what "sufficient" documentation actually looks like.
segments.tr: राज्यों का तर्क है कि उनसे अनुपालन बुनियादी ढांचा बनाने के लिए कहा जा रहा है — सत्यापन पोर्टल, अपील प्रक्रियाएं, चिकित्सा समीक्षा बोर्ड — बिना पर्याप्त धन, समयरेखा, या इस बात पर कानूनी स्पष्टता के कि "पर्याप्त" प्रलेखन वास्तव में कैसा दिखता है।

segments.src: The federal government, for its part, maintains that the standards are intended to preserve the integrity of a program designed to serve the most vulnerable, while still requiring meaningful proof for exemptions rather than accepting self-attestation or a single diagnosis code.
segments.tr: संघीय सरकार, अपनी ओर से, यह बनाए रखती है कि मानकों का उद्देश्य सबसे कमजोर लोगों की सेवा करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए कार्यक्रम की अखंडता को संरक्षित करना है, जबकि अभी भी स्व-प्रमाणन या एकल निदान कोड को स्वीकार करने के बजाय छूट के लिए सार्थक प्रमाण की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: That tension — between administrative rigor and access for people with genuine, hard-to-quantify limitations — is likely to be litigated for months before a clear national standard emerges.
segments.tr: वह तनाव — प्रशासनिक कठोरता और वास्तविक, मात्रा निर्धारित करने में कठिन सीमाओं वाले लोगों के लिए पहुंच के बीच — एक स्पष्ट राष्ट्रीय मानक उभरने से पहले महीनों तक मुकदमेबाजी होने की संभावना है।

segments.src: ## What This Means for Enrollees Right Now
segments.tr: ## इसका अभी नामांकित व्यक्तियों के लिए क्या मतलब है

segments.src: For Medicaid enrollees living with chronic or fluctuating health conditions, the immediate advice from patient advocacy groups is consistent: keep thorough medical records, including notes on how a condition affects daily functioning and work capacity, not just the diagnosis itself.
segments.tr: पुरानी या उतार-चढ़ाव वाली स्वास्थ्य स्थितियों के साथ रहने वाले मेडिकेड नामांकित व्यक्तियों के लिए, रोगी वकालत समूहों से तत्काल सलाह सुसंगत है: विस्तृत चिकित्सा रिकॉर्ड रखें, जिसमें इस बात के नोट्स शामिल हों कि एक स्थिति दैनिक कामकाज और कार्य क्षमता को कैसे प्रभावित करती है, न कि केवल निदान ही।

segments.src: Functional documentation — statements from treating physicians about limitations, frequency of flare-ups, or inability to sustain regular hours — may carry more weight under the new standards than a diagnosis alone.
segments.tr: कार्यात्मक प्रलेखन — सीमाओं, भड़कने की आवृत्ति, या नियमित घंटों को बनाए रखने में असमर्थता के बारे में उपचार करने वाले चिकित्सकों के बयान — नए मानकों के तहत केवल निदान की तुलना में अधिक वजन ले सकते हैं।

segments.src: State Medicaid websites and enrollment hotlines remain the most reliable source for current, state-specific exemption criteria, since implementation timelines and documentation requirements differ significantly depending on where the litigation and rulemaking process currently stands.
segments.tr: राज्य मेडिकेड वेबसाइटें और नामांकन हॉटलाइन वर्तमान, राज्य-विशिष्ट छूट मानदंडों के लिए सबसे विश्वसनीय स्रोत बनी हुई हैं, क्योंकि कार्यान्वयन समयसीमा और प्रलेखन आवश्यकताएं इस बात के आधार पर काफी भिन्न होती हैं कि मुकदमेबाजी और नियम बनाने की प्रक्रिया वर्तमान में कहां खड़ी है।

segments.src: Because this is an evolving legal and administrative situation, enrollees and providers should treat any specific requirement as subject to change until courts and CMS finalize guidance.
segments.tr: चूंकि यह एक विकसित कानूनी और प्रशासनिक स्थिति है, नामांकित व्यक्तियों और प्रदाताओं को किसी भी विशिष्ट आवश्यकता को तब तक परिवर्तन के अधीन मानना चाहिए जब तक कि अदालतें और CMS मार्गदर्शन को अंतिम रूप नहीं देते।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: This dispute is really about who bears the burden of proof in a safety-net program undergoing structural change.
segments.tr: यह विवाद वास्तव में इस बारे में है कि संरचनात्मक परिवर्तन से गुजर रहे सुरक्षा-नेट कार्यक्रम में सबूत का बोझ कौन उठाता है।

segments.src: As work requirements roll out nationally, the exemption question will likely serve as an early test case for how flexible — or how rigid — the new system becomes in practice.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे कार्य आवश्यकताएं राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर शुरू होती हैं, छूट का प्रश्न संभवतः इस बात के लिए एक प्रारंभिक परीक्षण मामले के रूप में काम करेगा कि नई प्रणाली व्यवहार में कितनी लचीली — या कितनी कठोर — हो जाती है।

segments.src: Whatever the courts and CMS ultimately decide, the outcome will shape not just paperwork, but whether people with real, if hard-to-categorize, health limitations retain access to coverage they depend on.
segments.tr: अदालतें और CMS अंततः जो कुछ भी तय करते हैं, परिणाम न केवल कागजी कार्रवाई को आकार देगा, बल्कि यह भी कि क्या वास्तविक, यदि वर्गीकृत करने में कठिन, स्वास्थ्य सीमाओं वाले लोग उस कवरेज तक पहुंच बनाए रखते हैं जिस पर वे निर्भर हैं।

es.title: Lo suficientemente enfermo para faltar al trabajo, pero no lo suficiente para CMS: La lucha interna de los estados por las exenciones de Medicaid

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem
segments.tr: ## Una nueva regla, un viejo problema

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.
segments.tr: Los requisitos de trabajo de Medicaid ya no son un debate político hipotético; se están convirtiendo en una realidad administrativa que las agencias estatales deben implementar, a menudo con una orientación limitada y aún menos tiempo.

segments.src: At the center of the current confusion is a seemingly narrow question with enormous consequences for millions of low-income Americans: what actually counts as being "too sick to work"?
segments.tr: En el centro de la confusión actual se encuentra una pregunta aparentemente estrecha con enormes consecuencias para millones de estadounidenses de bajos ingresos: ¿qué cuenta realmente como estar "demasiado enfermo para trabajar"?

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.
segments.tr: Durante años, los estados que querían probar los requisitos de trabajo asumieron que un diagnóstico médico documentado (una enfermedad crónica, una condición de salud mental, una determinación de discapacidad) sería suficiente para eximir a alguien de la notificación obligatoria de horas de trabajo.

segments.src: Federal guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has complicated that assumption, signaling that a diagnosis alone may not automatically satisfy the "medically frail" or "unable to work" exemption categories written into the new rules.
segments.tr: La orientación federal de los Centros de Servicios de Medicare y Medicaid (CMS) ha complicado esa suposición, señalando que un diagnóstico por sí solo puede no satisfacer automáticamente las categorías de exención de "médicamente frágil" o "incapaz de trabajar" escritas en las nuevas reglas.

segments.src: Instead, states may need to evaluate functional capacity, severity, and documentation in ways that go well beyond a doctor's note.
segments.tr: En cambio, es posible que los estados necesiten evaluar la capacidad funcional, la gravedad y la documentación de maneras que van mucho más allá de una nota del médico.

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa la distinción

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: La brecha práctica entre "diagnosticado" y "lo suficientemente discapacitado para estar exento" es donde aterriza el impacto en el mundo real.

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
segments.tr: Alguien que maneja una enfermedad grave pero episódica (ciertas condiciones autoinmunes, crisis recurrentes de salud mental, trastornos de dolor crónico) puede ser incapaz de mantener un trabajo de manera confiable en un horario fijo, pero puede no cumplir con un umbral clínico estricto para una exención formal.

segments.src: State Medicaid agencies, which already run on tight budgets and understaffed eligibility offices, are now being asked to build verification systems that can make these fine-grained distinctions consistently and fairly, often on compressed timelines.
segments.tr: A las agencias estatales de Medicaid, que ya operan con presupuestos ajustados y oficinas de elegibilidad con poco personal, se les pide ahora que construyan sistemas de verificación que puedan hacer estas distinciones detalladas de manera consistente y justa, a menudo en plazos comprimidos.

segments.src: Advocates for low-income patients warn that ambiguity in the standard risks two failure modes at once: exemptions denied to people who genuinely cannot maintain steady employment, and inconsistent application from state to state that leaves similarly situated patients with very different outcomes depending on where they live.
segments.tr: Los defensores de los pacientes de bajos ingresos advierten que la ambigüedad en el estándar arriesga dos modos de falla a la vez: exenciones denegadas a personas que genuinamente no pueden mantener un empleo estable, y una aplicación inconsistente de un estado a otro que deja a pacientes en situaciones similares con resultados muy diferentes dependiendo de dónde vivan.

segments.src: Supporters of work requirements counter that clearer, stricter documentation standards are necessary to prevent misuse of exemptions and to ensure the policy achieves its intended goal of encouraging workforce participation among able-bodied adults.
segments.tr: Los partidarios de los requisitos de trabajo responden que son necesarios estándares de documentación más claros y estrictos para evitar el uso indebido de las exenciones y para garantizar que la política logre su objetivo previsto de fomentar la participación laboral entre los adultos capaces físicamente.

segments.src: ## States Push Back in Court
segments.tr: ## Los estados contraatacan en los tribunales

segments.src: The disagreement has moved beyond policy memos and into the courtroom.
segments.tr: El desacuerdo ha ido más allá de los memorandos de política y ha llegado a la sala del tribunal.

segments.src: A coalition of roughly two dozen states has filed suit against the federal government, arguing that the exemption guidance is unclear, procedurally flawed, or imposes burdens that federal law never intended for state agencies to carry.
segments.tr: Una coalición de aproximadamente dos docenas de estados ha presentado una demanda contra el gobierno federal, argumentando que la orientación sobre exenciones no es clara, tiene fallas procesales o impone cargas que la ley federal nunca tuvo la intención de que las agencias estatales soportaran.

segments.src: The states argue they are being asked to build compliance infrastructure — verification portals, appeals processes, medical review boards — without adequate funding, timeline, or legal clarity on what "sufficient" documentation actually looks like.
segments.tr: Los estados argumentan que se les está pidiendo que construyan una infraestructura de cumplimiento (portales de verificación, procesos de apelación, juntas de revisión médica) sin la financiación, el cronograma o la claridad legal adecuados sobre cómo es realmente una documentación "suficiente".

segments.src: The federal government, for its part, maintains that the standards are intended to preserve the integrity of a program designed to serve the most vulnerable, while still requiring meaningful proof for exemptions rather than accepting self-attestation or a single diagnosis code.
segments.tr: El gobierno federal, por su parte, sostiene que los estándares tienen la intención de preservar la integridad de un programa diseñado para servir a los más vulnerables, mientras se sigue requiriendo una prueba significativa para las exenciones en lugar de aceptar la auto-atestación o un solo código de diagnóstico.

segments.src: That tension — between administrative rigor and access for people with genuine, hard-to-quantify limitations — is likely to be litigated for months before a clear national standard emerges.
segments.tr: Esa tensión (entre el rigor administrativo y el acceso para personas con limitaciones genuinas y difíciles de cuantificar) probablemente será litigada durante meses antes de que surja un estándar nacional claro.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Enrollees Right Now
segments.tr: ## Lo que esto significa para los inscritos en este momento

segments.src: For Medicaid enrollees living with chronic or fluctuating health conditions, the immediate advice from patient advocacy groups is consistent: keep thorough medical records, including notes on how a condition affects daily functioning and work capacity, not just the diagnosis itself.
segments.tr: Para los inscritos en Medicaid que viven con condiciones de salud crónicas o fluctuantes, el consejo inmediato de los grupos de defensa de los pacientes es consistente: mantenga registros médicos exhaustivos, incluidas notas sobre cómo una condición afecta el funcionamiento diario y la capacidad laboral, no solo el diagnóstico en sí.

segments.src: Functional documentation — statements from treating physicians about limitations, frequency of flare-ups, or inability to sustain regular hours — may carry more weight under the new standards than a diagnosis alone.
segments.tr: La documentación funcional (declaraciones de los médicos tratantes sobre las limitaciones, la frecuencia de los brotes o la incapacidad para mantener horarios regulares) puede tener más peso bajo los nuevos estándares que un diagnóstico por sí solo.

segments.src: State Medicaid websites and enrollment hotlines remain the most reliable source for current, state-specific exemption criteria, since implementation timelines and documentation requirements differ significantly depending on where the litigation and rulemaking process currently stands.
segments.tr: Los sitios web estatales de Medicaid y las líneas directas de inscripción siguen siendo la fuente más confiable para los criterios de exención actuales y específicos de cada estado, ya que los plazos de implementación y los requisitos de documentación difieren significativamente dependiendo de dónde se encuentre actualmente el proceso de litigio y reglamentación.

segments.src: Because this is an evolving legal and administrative situation, enrollees and providers should treat any specific requirement as subject to change until courts and CMS finalize guidance.
segments.tr: Debido a que esta es una situación legal y administrativa en evolución, los inscritos y los proveedores deben tratar cualquier requisito específico como sujeto a cambios hasta que los tribunales y los CMS finalicen la orientación.

ar.title: مريض بما يكفي للتغيب عن العمل، وليس مريضاً بما يكفي لـ CMS: نظرة على صراع الولايات حول إعفاءات برنامج ميديكيد (Medicaid)

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem
segments.tr: ## قاعدة جديدة، مشكلة قديمة

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.
segments.tr: لم تعد متطلبات العمل في برنامج ميديكيد (Medicaid) مجرد نقاش سياسي افتراضي، بل أصبحت واقعاً إدارياً يجب على وكالات الولايات تنفيذه، وغالباً ما يتم ذلك بتوجيهات محدودة ووقت أقل.

segments.src: At the center of the current confusion is a seemingly narrow question with enormous consequences for millions of low-income Americans: what actually counts as being "too sick to work"?
segments.tr: في قلب الارتباك الحالي تكمن مسألة تبدو ضيقة ولكن لها عواقب وخيمة على ملايين الأمريكيين ذوي الدخل المنخفض: ما الذي يُعتبر فعلياً "مريضاً جداً بحيث لا يستطيع العمل"؟

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.
segments.tr: لسنوات، افترضت الولايات التي أرادت اختبار متطلبات العمل أن التشخيص الطبي الموثق - سواء كان مرضاً مزمناً، أو حالة صحية عقلية، أو تحديداً للإعاقة - سيكون كافياً لإعفاء شخص ما من الإبلاغ الإلزامي عن ساعات العمل.

segments.src: Federal guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has complicated that assumption, signaling that a diagnosis alone may not automatically satisfy the "medically frail" or "unable to work" exemption categories written into the new rules.
segments.tr: لقد عقدت التوجيهات الفيدرالية الصادرة عن مراكز خدمات الرعاية الطبية والخدمات الطبية (CMS) هذا الافتراض، مشيرة إلى أن التشخيص وحده قد لا يستوفي تلقائياً فئات الإعفاء الخاصة بـ "الضعف الطبي" أو "عدم القدرة على العمل" المنصوص عليها في القواعد الجديدة.

segments.src: Instead, states may need to evaluate functional capacity, severity, and documentation in ways that go well beyond a doctor's note.
segments.tr: بدلاً من ذلك، قد تحتاج الولايات إلى تقييم القدرة الوظيفية، والشدة، والتوثيق بطرق تتجاوز بكثير مجرد ملاحظة الطبيب.

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم هذا التمييز

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: الفجوة العملية بين "التشخيص" و"الإعاقة الكافية للإعفاء" هي المكان الذي يظهر فيه التأثير الواقعي.

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
segments.tr: قد يكون الشخص الذي يعاني من مرض خطير ولكنه متقطع - مثل بعض حالات المناعة الذاتية، أو نوبات الصحة العقلية المتكررة، أو اضطرابات الألم المزمن - غير قادر على الاحتفاظ بوظيفة بشكل موثوق في جدول زمني ثابت، ومع ذلك قد لا يستوفي العتبة السريرية الصارمة للحصول على إعفاء رسمي.

segments.src: State Medicaid agencies, which already run on tight budgets and understaffed eligibility offices, are now being asked to build verification systems that can make these fine-grained distinctions consistently and fairly, often on compressed timelines.
segments.tr: يُطلب الآن من وكالات ميديكيد في الولايات، التي تعمل بالفعل بميزانيات محدودة ومكاتب أهلية تعاني من نقص في الموظفين، بناء أنظمة تحقق يمكنها إجراء هذه التمييزات الدقيقة بشكل متسق وعادل، وغالباً في جداول زمنية مضغوطة.

segments.src: Advocates for low-income patients warn that ambiguity in the standard risks two failure modes at once: exemptions denied to people who genuinely cannot maintain steady employment, and inconsistent application from state to state that leaves similarly situated patients with very different outcomes depending on where they live.
segments.tr: يحذر المدافعون عن المرضى ذوي الدخل المنخفض من أن الغموض في المعايير يخاطر بوقوع نمطين من الفشل في آن واحد: رفض الإعفاءات لأشخاص لا يستطيعون حقاً الحفاظ على عمل ثابت، وتطبيق غير متسق من ولاية إلى أخرى يترك المرضى في أوضاع متشابهة بنتائج مختلفة جداً اعتماداً على مكان إقامتهم.

segments.src: Supporters of work requirements counter that clearer, stricter documentation standards are necessary to prevent misuse of exemptions and to ensure the policy achieves its intended goal of encouraging workforce participation among able-bodied adults.
segments.tr: يرد مؤيدو متطلبات العمل بأن معايير التوثيق الأكثر وضوحاً وصرامة ضرورية لمنع إساءة استخدام الإعفاءات ولضمان تحقيق السياسة لهدفها المقصود المتمثل في تشجيع المشاركة في القوى العاملة بين البالغين القادرين على العمل.

segments.tr: انتقل الخلاف إلى ما هو أبعد من مذكرات السياسة وإلى قاعة المحكمة.

segments.tr: رفعت مجموعة تضم حوالي عشرين ولاية دعوى قضائية ضد الحكومة الفيدرالية، بحجة أن توجيهات الإعفاء غير واضحة، أو معيبة إجرائياً، أو تفرض أعباء لم يقصد القانون الفيدرالي أبداً أن تتحملها وكالات الولايات.

segments.src: The states argue they are being asked to build compliance infrastructure — verification portals, appeals processes, medical review boards — without adequate funding, timeline, or legal clarity on what "sufficient" documentation actually looks like.
segments.tr: تجادل الولايات بأنه يُطلب منها بناء بنية تحتية للامتثال - بوابات التحقق، وعمليات الاستئناف، ومجالس المراجعة الطبية - دون تمويل كافٍ، أو جدول زمني مناسب، أو وضوح قانوني بشأن ما يبدو عليه التوثيق "الكافي" فعلياً.

segments.src: The federal government, for its part, maintains that the standards are intended to preserve the integrity of a program designed to serve the most vulnerable, while still requiring meaningful proof for exemptions rather than accepting self-attestation or a single diagnosis code.
segments.tr: من جانبها، تؤكد الحكومة الفيدرالية أن المعايير تهدف إلى الحفاظ على نزاهة برنامج مصمم لخدمة الفئات الأكثر ضعفاً، مع الاستمرار في طلب إثباتات ذات مغزى للإعفاءات بدلاً من قبول الإقرار الذاتي أو رمز تشخيص واحد.

segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للمسجلين في الوقت الحالي

fr.title: Assez malade pour manquer le travail, pas assez pour le CMS : Dans les coulisses de la course des États pour les exemptions Medicaid

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem
segments.tr: ## Une nouvelle règle, un vieux problème

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.
segments.tr: Les exigences de travail pour Medicaid ne sont plus un débat politique hypothétique — elles deviennent une réalité administrative que les agences étatiques doivent mettre en œuvre, souvent avec des directives limitées et encore moins de temps.

segments.src: At the center of the current confusion is a seemingly narrow question with enormous consequences for millions of low-income Americans: what actually counts as being "too sick to work"?
segments.tr: Au cœur de la confusion actuelle se trouve une question apparemment étroite mais aux conséquences énormes pour des millions d'Américains à faible revenu : qu'est-ce qui est réellement considéré comme étant « trop malade pour travailler » ?

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.
segments.tr: Pendant des années, les États qui souhaitaient tester les exigences de travail supposaient qu'un diagnostic médical documenté — une maladie chronique, un trouble de la santé mentale, une détermination d'invalidité — suffirait à exempter une personne de la déclaration obligatoire des heures de travail.

segments.src: Federal guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has complicated that assumption, signaling that a diagnosis alone may not automatically satisfy the "medically frail" or "unable to work" exemption categories written into the new rules.
segments.tr: Les directives fédérales des Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) ont compliqué cette hypothèse, signalant qu'un diagnostic seul ne suffit pas nécessairement à satisfaire automatiquement aux catégories d'exemption pour les personnes « médicalement fragiles » ou « incapables de travailler » inscrites dans les nouvelles règles.

segments.src: Instead, states may need to evaluate functional capacity, severity, and documentation in ways that go well beyond a doctor's note.
segments.tr: Au lieu de cela, les États pourraient devoir évaluer la capacité fonctionnelle, la gravité et la documentation d'une manière qui va bien au-delà d'un simple certificat médical.

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la distinction est importante

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: C'est dans l'écart pratique entre « diagnostiqué » et « suffisamment handicapé pour être exempté » que se fait ressentir l'impact dans le monde réel.

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
segments.tr: Une personne gérant une maladie grave mais épisodique — certaines affections auto-immunes, des crises de santé mentale récurrentes, des troubles de douleur chronique — peut être incapable d'occuper un emploi de manière fiable selon un horaire fixe, sans pour autant atteindre le seuil clinique strict pour une exemption formelle.

segments.src: State Medicaid agencies, which already run on tight budgets and understaffed eligibility offices, are now being asked to build verification systems that can make these fine-grained distinctions consistently and fairly, often on compressed timelines.
segments.tr: Les agences Medicaid des États, qui fonctionnent déjà avec des budgets serrés et des bureaux d'éligibilité en sous-effectif, se voient désormais demander de mettre en place des systèmes de vérification capables de faire ces distinctions subtiles de manière cohérente et équitable, souvent dans des délais très courts.

segments.src: Advocates for low-income patients warn that ambiguity in the standard risks two failure modes at once: exemptions denied to people who genuinely cannot maintain steady employment, and inconsistent application from state to state that leaves similarly situated patients with very different outcomes depending on where they live.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs des patients à faible revenu avertissent que l'ambiguïté de la norme risque d'entraîner deux types d'échecs à la fois : des exemptions refusées à des personnes qui ne peuvent véritablement pas maintenir un emploi stable, et une application incohérente d'un État à l'autre qui laisse des patients dans des situations similaires avec des résultats très différents selon leur lieu de résidence.

segments.src: Supporters of work requirements counter that clearer, stricter documentation standards are necessary to prevent misuse of exemptions and to ensure the policy achieves its intended goal of encouraging workforce participation among able-bodied adults.
segments.tr: Les partisans des exigences de travail rétorquent que des normes de documentation plus claires et plus strictes sont nécessaires pour éviter l'utilisation abusive des exemptions et pour garantir que la politique atteigne son objectif initial d'encourager la participation à la population active des adultes valides.

segments.src: ## States Push Back in Court
segments.tr: ## Les États contestent devant les tribunaux

segments.src: The disagreement has moved beyond policy memos and into the courtroom.
segments.tr: Le désaccord a dépassé le cadre des notes d'orientation politique pour entrer dans les tribunaux.

segments.src: A coalition of roughly two dozen states has filed suit against the federal government, arguing that the exemption guidance is unclear, procedurally flawed, or imposes burdens that federal law never intended for state agencies to carry.
segments.tr: Une coalition d'environ deux douzaines d'États a intenté une action en justice contre le gouvernement fédéral, arguant que les directives d'exemption sont floues, entachées de vices de procédure ou qu'elles imposent des charges que la loi fédérale n'a jamais eu l'intention de faire porter aux agences étatiques.

segments.src: The states argue they are being asked to build compliance infrastructure — verification portals, appeals processes, medical review boards — without adequate funding, timeline, or legal clarity on what "sufficient" documentation actually looks like.
segments.tr: Les États soutiennent qu'on leur demande de mettre en place une infrastructure de conformité — portails de vérification, processus d'appel, commissions d'examen médical — sans financement adéquat, sans calendrier réaliste ni clarté juridique sur ce à quoi ressemble réellement une documentation « suffisante ».

segments.src: The federal government, for its part, maintains that the standards are intended to preserve the integrity of a program designed to serve the most vulnerable, while still requiring meaningful proof for exemptions rather than accepting self-attestation or a single diagnosis code.
segments.tr: Le gouvernement fédéral, de son côté, soutient que les normes visent à préserver l'intégrité d'un programme conçu pour servir les plus vulnérables, tout en exigeant des preuves significatives pour les exemptions plutôt que d'accepter une simple auto-attestation ou un code de diagnostic unique.

segments.src: That tension — between administrative rigor and access for people with genuine, hard-to-quantify limitations — is likely to be litigated for months before a clear national standard emerges.
segments.tr: Cette tension — entre rigueur administrative et accès pour les personnes ayant des limites réelles et difficiles à quantifier — fera probablement l'objet de litiges pendant des mois avant qu'une norme nationale claire n'émerge.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Enrollees Right Now
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les bénéficiaires dès maintenant

segments.src: For Medicaid enrollees living with chronic or fluctuating health conditions, the immediate advice from patient advocacy groups is consistent: keep thorough medical records, including notes on how a condition affects daily functioning and work capacity, not just the diagnosis itself.
segments.tr: Pour les bénéficiaires de Medicaid vivant avec des problèmes de santé chroniques ou fluctuants, le conseil immédiat des groupes de défense des patients est constant : conservez des dossiers médicaux complets, y compris des notes sur la façon dont une affection affecte le fonctionnement quotidien et la capacité de travail, et pas seulement le diagnostic lui-même.

segments.src: Functional documentation — statements from treating physicians about limitations, frequency of flare-ups, or inability to sustain regular hours — may carry more weight under the new standards than a diagnosis alone.
segments.tr: La documentation fonctionnelle — les déclarations des médecins traitants concernant les limites, la fréquence des poussées ou l'incapacité à maintenir des horaires réguliers — peut avoir plus de poids sous les nouvelles normes qu'un simple diagnostic.

segments.src: State Medicaid websites and enrollment hotlines remain the most reliable source for current, state-specific exemption criteria, since implementation timelines and documentation requirements differ significantly depending on where the litigation and rulemaking process currently stands.
segments.tr: Les sites Web de Medicaid des États et les lignes d'assistance téléphonique pour les inscriptions restent la source la plus fiable pour connaître les critères d'exemption actuels et spécifiques à chaque État, car les calendriers de mise en œuvre et les exigences de documentation diffèrent considérablement selon l'état d'avancement des litiges et du processus d'élaboration des règles.

segments.src: Because this is an evolving legal and administrative situation, enrollees and providers should treat any specific requirement as subject to change until courts and CMS finalize guidance.
segments.tr: S'agissant d'une situation juridique et administrative en constante évolution, les bénéficiaires et les prestataires de soins doivent considérer toute exigence spécifique comme sujette à modification jusqu'à ce que les tribunaux et le CMS finalisent les directives.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture

segments.src: As work requirements roll out nationally, the exemption question will likely serve as an early test case for how flexible — or how rigid — the new system becomes in practice.
segments.tr: À mesure que les exigences de travail se déploient à l'échelle nationale, la question de l'exemption servira probablement de premier test pour évaluer à quel point le nouveau système deviendra flexible — ou rigide — dans la pratique.

segments.src: Whatever the courts and CMS ultimately decide, the outcome will shape not just paperwork, but whether people with real, if hard-to-categorize, health limitations retain access to coverage they depend on.

pt.title: Doente o Suficiente para Faltar ao Trabalho, Não Doente o Suficiente para o CMS: Por Dentro da Corrida dos Estados por Isenções do Medicaid

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem
segments.tr: ## Uma Nova Regra, um Velho Problema

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.
segments.tr: Os requisitos de trabalho do Medicaid não são mais um debate político hipotético — eles estão se tornando uma realidade administrativa que as agências estaduais devem implementar, muitas vezes com orientações limitadas e ainda menos tempo.

segments.src: At the center of the current confusion is a seemingly narrow question with enormous consequences for millions of low-income Americans: what actually counts as being "too sick to work"?
segments.tr: No centro da confusão atual está uma questão aparentemente restrita com consequências enormes para milhões de americanos de baixa renda: o que realmente conta como "muito doente para trabalhar"?

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.
segments.tr: Durante anos, os estados que queriam testar os requisitos de trabalho assumiram que um diagnóstico médico documentado — uma doença crônica, uma condição de saúde mental, uma determinação de deficiência — seria suficiente para isentar alguém da obrigatoriedade de relatar horas de trabalho.

segments.src: Federal guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has complicated that assumption, signaling that a diagnosis alone may not automatically satisfy the "medically frail" or "unable to work" exemption categories written into the new rules.
segments.tr: As orientações federais dos Centros de Serviços de Medicare e Medicaid (CMS) complicaram essa suposição, sinalizando que apenas um diagnóstico pode não satisfazer automaticamente as categorias de isenção de "fragilidade médica" ou "incapacidade para o trabalho" escritas nas novas regras.

segments.src: Instead, states may need to evaluate functional capacity, severity, and documentation in ways that go well beyond a doctor's note.
segments.tr: Em vez disso, os estados podem precisar avaliar a capacidade funcional, a gravidade e a documentação de maneiras que vão muito além de um atestado médico.

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## Por Que a Distinção Importa

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: A lacuna prática entre "diagnosticado" e "incapacitado o suficiente para ser isento" é onde o impacto no mundo real acontece.

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
segments.tr: Alguém que gerencia uma doença grave, mas episódica — certas condições autoimunes, crises recorrentes de saúde mental, distúrbios de dor crônica —, pode ser incapaz de manter um emprego de forma confiável em um horário fixo, mas pode não atingir um limiar clínico rigoroso para uma isenção formal.

segments.src: State Medicaid agencies, which already run on tight budgets and understaffed eligibility offices, are now being asked to build verification systems that can make these fine-grained distinctions consistently and fairly, often on compressed timelines.
segments.tr: As agências estaduais do Medicaid, que já operam com orçamentos apertados e escritórios de elegibilidade com falta de pessoal, estão agora sendo solicitadas a construir sistemas de verificação que possam fazer essas distinções sutis de forma consistente e justa, muitas vezes em prazos comprimidos.

segments.src: Advocates for low-income patients warn that ambiguity in the standard risks two failure modes at once: exemptions denied to people who genuinely cannot maintain steady employment, and inconsistent application from state to state that leaves similarly situated patients with very different outcomes depending on where they live.
segments.tr: Defensores de pacientes de baixa renda alertam que a ambiguidade no padrão arrisca dois modos de falha ao mesmo tempo: isenções negadas a pessoas que genuinamente não conseguem manter um emprego estável e aplicação inconsistente de estado para estado que deixa pacientes em situações semelhantes com resultados muito diferentes, dependendo de onde moram.

segments.src: Supporters of work requirements counter that clearer, stricter documentation standards are necessary to prevent misuse of exemptions and to ensure the policy achieves its intended goal of encouraging workforce participation among able-bodied adults.
segments.tr: Apoiadores dos requisitos de trabalho retrucam que padrões de documentação mais claros e rigorosos são necessários para evitar o uso indevido de isenções e para garantir que a política alcance seu objetivo pretendido de incentivar a participação da força de trabalho entre adultos válidos.

segments.src: ## States Push Back in Court
segments.tr: ## Estados Reagem na Justiça

segments.src: The disagreement has moved beyond policy memos and into the courtroom.
segments.tr: A divergência passou dos memorandos políticos para os tribunais.

segments.src: A coalition of roughly two dozen states has filed suit against the federal government, arguing that the exemption guidance is unclear, procedurally flawed, or imposes burdens that federal law never intended for state agencies to carry.
segments.tr: Uma coalizão de cerca de duas dúzias de estados entrou com uma ação contra o governo federal, argumentando que a orientação de isenção não é clara, é falha processualmente ou impõe ônus que a lei federal nunca teve a intenção de que as agências estaduais carregassem.

segments.src: The states argue they are being asked to build compliance infrastructure — verification portals, appeals processes, medical review boards — without adequate funding, timeline, or legal clarity on what "sufficient" documentation actually looks like.
segments.tr: Os estados argumentam que lhes está sendo pedido que construam infraestrutura de conformidade — portais de verificação, processos de apuração, conselhos de revisão médica — sem financiamento adequado, cronograma ou clareza legal sobre como é realmente uma documentação "suficiente".

segments.src: The federal government, for its part, maintains that the standards are intended to preserve the integrity of a program designed to serve the most vulnerable, while still requiring meaningful proof for exemptions rather than accepting self-attestation or a single diagnosis code.
segments.tr: O governo federal, por sua vez, sustenta que os padrões destinam-se a preservar a integridade de um programa projetado para atender aos mais vulneráveis, ao mesmo tempo em que exige provas significativas para isenções, em vez de aceitar auto-atestado ou um único código de diagnóstico.

segments.src: That tension — between administrative rigor and access for people with genuine, hard-to-quantify limitations — is likely to be litigated for months before a clear national standard emerges.
segments.tr: Essa tensão — entre rigor administrativo e acesso para pessoas com limitações genuínas e difíceis de quantificar — provavelmente será litigada por meses antes que um padrão nacional claro emerja.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Enrollees Right Now
segments.tr: ## O Que Isso Significa para os Inscritos Agora

segments.src: For Medicaid enrollees living with chronic or fluctuating health conditions, the immediate advice from patient advocacy groups is consistent: keep thorough medical records, including notes on how a condition affects daily functioning and work capacity, not just the diagnosis itself.
segments.tr: Para os inscritos no Medicaid que vivem com condições de saúde crônicas ou flutuantes, o conselho imediato de grupos de defesa dos pacientes é consistente: mantenha registros médicos completos, incluindo notas sobre como uma condição afeta o funcionamento diário e a capacidade de trabalho, e não apenas o diagnóstico em si.

segments.src: Functional documentation — statements from treating physicians about limitations, frequency of flare-ups, or inability to sustain regular hours — may carry more weight under the new standards than a diagnosis alone.
segments.tr: A documentação funcional — declarações de médicos assistentes sobre limitações, frequência de crises ou incapacidade de sustentar horários regulares — pode ter mais peso sob os novos padrões do que apenas um diagnóstico.

segments.src: State Medicaid websites and enrollment hotlines remain the most reliable source for current, state-specific exemption criteria, since implementation timelines and documentation requirements differ significantly depending on where the litigation and rulemaking process currently stands.
segments.tr: Os sites estaduais do Medicaid e as linhas diretas de inscrição continuam sendo a fonte mais confiável para critérios de isenção atuais e específicos do estado, uma vez que os cronogramas de implementação e os requisitos de documentação diferem significativamente dependendo de onde o processo de litígio e elaboração de regras se encontra atualmente.

segments.src: Because this is an evolving legal and administrative situation, enrollees and providers should treat any specific requirement as subject to change until courts and CMS finalize guidance.
segments.tr: Como esta é uma situação legal e administrativa em evolução, os inscritos e os provedores devem tratar qualquer requisito específico como sujeito a alterações até que os tribunais e o CMS finalize a orientação.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## O Contexto Geral

segments.src: This dispute is really about who bears the burden of proof in a safety-net program undergoing structural change.
segments.tr: Esta disputa trata realmente de quem carrega o ônus da prova em um programa de rede de segurança que passa por mudanças estruturais.

segments.src: As work requirements roll out nationally, the exemption question will likely serve as an early test case for how flexible — or how rigid — the new system becomes in practice.
segments.tr: À medida que os requisitos de trabalho são implementados nacionalmente, a questão da isenção provavelmente servirá como um caso de teste inicial para quão flexível — ou quão rígido — o novo sistema se tornará na prática.

segments.src: Whatever the courts and CMS ultimately decide, the outcome will shape not just paperwork, but whether people with real, if hard-to-categorize, health limitations retain access to coverage they depend on.
segments.tr: Independentemente do que os tribunais e o CMS decidam em última análise, o resultado moldará não apenas a papelada, mas se as pessoas com limitações de saúde reais, embora difíceis de categorizar, mantêm o acesso à cobertura de que dependem.

in.title: Cukup Sakit untuk Tidak Bekerja, Tidak Cukup Sakit untuk CMS: Di Balik Perebutan Bebas Syarat Medicaid oleh Negara Bagian

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem
segments.tr: ## Aturan Baru, Masalah Lama

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.
segments.tr: Persyaratan kerja Medicaid tidak lagi menjadi perdebatan kebijakan hipotetis — ini menjadi kenyataan administratif yang harus diterapkan oleh badan-badan negara bagian, sering kali dengan panduan yang terbatas dan waktu yang lebih sedikit.

segments.src: At the center of the current confusion is a seemingly narrow question with enormous consequences for millions of low-income Americans: what actually counts as being "too sick to work"?
segments.tr: Di pusat kebingungan saat ini adalah pertanyaan yang tampaknya sempit tetapi berdampak besar bagi jutaan warga Amerika berpenghasilan rendah: apa yang sebenarnya dianggap sebagai "terlalu sakit untuk bekerja"?

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.
segments.tr: Selama bertahun-tahun, negara bagian yang ingin menguji persyaratan kerja mengasumsikan bahwa diagnosis medis yang terdokumentasi — penyakit kronis, kondisi kesehatan mental, penentuan disabilitas — akan cukup untuk membebaskan seseorang dari pelaporan jam kerja wajib.

segments.src: Federal guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has complicated that assumption, signaling that a diagnosis alone may not automatically satisfy the "medically frail" or "unable to work" exemption categories written into the new rules.
segments.tr: Panduan federal dari Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) telah merumitkan asumsi tersebut, memberi sinyal bahwa diagnosis saja mungkin tidak secara otomatis memenuhi kategori pembebasan "lemah secara medis" atau "tidak mampu bekerja" yang tertulis dalam aturan baru.

segments.src: Instead, states may need to evaluate functional capacity, severity, and documentation in ways that go well beyond a doctor's note.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, negara bagian mungkin perlu mengevaluasi kapasitas fungsional, keparahan, dan dokumentasi dengan cara yang melampaui surat keterangan dokter.

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Perbedaan Ini Penting

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: Celah praktis antara "telah didiagnosis" dan "cukup penyandang disabilitas untuk dibebaskan" adalah tempat dampak dunia nyata terjadi.

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
segments.tr: Seseorang yang mengelola penyakit serius tetapi episodik — kondisi autoimun tertentu, krisis kesehatan mental yang berulang, gangguan nyeri kronis — mungkin tidak dapat mempertahankan pekerjaan secara andal dengan jadwal tetap, namun mungkin tidak memenuhi ambang batas klinis yang ketat untuk pembebasan formal.

segments.src: State Medicaid agencies, which already run on tight budgets and understaffed eligibility offices, are now being asked to build verification systems that can make these fine-grained distinctions consistently and fairly, often on compressed timelines.
segments.tr: Badan Medicaid negara bagian, yang sudah beroperasi dengan anggaran ketat dan kantor kelayakan yang kekurangan staf, kini diminta untuk membangun sistem verifikasi yang dapat membuat perbedaan halus ini secara konsisten dan adil, sering kali dalam tenggat waktu yang singkat.

segments.src: Advocates for low-income patients warn that ambiguity in the standard risks two failure modes at once: exemptions denied to people who genuinely cannot maintain steady employment, and inconsistent application from state to state that leaves similarly situated patients with very different outcomes depending on where they live.
segments.tr: Pembela pasien berpenghasilan rendah memperingatkan bahwa ambiguitas dalam standar berisiko mengalami dua jenis kegagalan sekaligus: pembebasan ditolak untuk orang yang benar-benar tidak dapat mempertahankan pekerjaan tetap, dan penerapan yang tidak konsisten dari satu negara bagian ke negara bagian lain yang membuat pasien dengan situasi serupa mendapatkan hasil yang sangat berbeda tergantung tempat tinggal mereka.

segments.src: Supporters of work requirements counter that clearer, stricter documentation standards are necessary to prevent misuse of exemptions and to ensure the policy achieves its intended goal of encouraging workforce participation among able-bodied adults.
segments.tr: Pendukung persyaratan kerja membantah bahwa standar dokumentasi yang lebih jelas dan lebih ketat diperlukan untuk mencegah penyalahgunaan pembebasan dan untuk memastikan kebijakan mencapai tujuan yang dimaksudkan untuk mendorong partisipasi angkatan kerja di antara orang dewasa yang sehat secara fisik.

segments.src: ## States Push Back in Court
segments.tr: ## Negara Bagian Melawan di Pengadilan

segments.src: The disagreement has moved beyond policy memos and into the courtroom.
segments.tr: Perselisihan telah meluas melampaui memo kebijakan dan masuk ke ruang sidang.

segments.src: A coalition of roughly two dozen states has filed suit against the federal government, arguing that the exemption guidance is unclear, procedurally flawed, or imposes burdens that federal law never intended for state agencies to carry.
segments.tr: Koalisi sekitar dua lusin negara bagian telah mengajukan gugatan terhadap pemerintah federal, berargumen bahwa panduan pembebasan tidak jelas, cacat secara prosedural, atau membebankan beban yang tidak pernah dimaksudkan oleh hukum federal untuk ditanggung oleh badan-badan negara bagian.

segments.src: The states argue they are being asked to build compliance infrastructure — verification portals, appeals processes, medical review boards — without adequate funding, timeline, or legal clarity on what "sufficient" documentation actually looks like.
segments.tr: Negara bagian berargumen bahwa mereka diminta untuk membangun infrastruktur kepatuhan — portal verifikasi, proses banding, dewan peninjau medis — tanpa pendanaan, tenggat waktu, atau kejelasan hukum yang memadai tentang seperti apa bentuk dokumentasi yang "cukup".

segments.src: The federal government, for its part, maintains that the standards are intended to preserve the integrity of a program designed to serve the most vulnerable, while still requiring meaningful proof for exemptions rather than accepting self-attestation or a single diagnosis code.
segments.tr: Pemerintah federal, pada bagiannya, mempertahankan bahwa standar tersebut dimaksudkan untuk menjaga integritas program yang dirancang untuk melayani mereka yang paling rentan, sambil tetap membutuhkan bukti yang bermakna untuk pembebasan daripada menerima pengakuan diri sendiri atau kode diagnosis tunggal.

segments.src: That tension — between administrative rigor and access for people with genuine, hard-to-quantify limitations — is likely to be litigated for months before a clear national standard emerges.
segments.tr: Ketegangan itu — antara ketegasan administratif dan akses bagi orang-orang dengan keterbatasan nyata yang sulit dikuantifikasi — kemungkinan akan diperkarakan selama berbulan-bulan sebelum standar nasional yang jelas muncul.

segments.src: ## What This Means for Enrollees Right Now
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya Ini Bagi Peserta Saat Ini

segments.src: For Medicaid enrollees living with chronic or fluctuating health conditions, the immediate advice from patient advocacy groups is consistent: keep thorough medical records, including notes on how a condition affects daily functioning and work capacity, not just the diagnosis itself.
segments.tr: Bagi peserta Medicaid yang hidup dengan kondisi kesehatan kronis atau fluktuatif, saran langsung dari kelompok pembela pasien konsisten: simpan rekam medis yang mendalam, termasuk catatan tentang bagaimana suatu kondisi memengaruhi fungsi sehari-hari dan kapasitas kerja, bukan hanya diagnosis itu sendiri.

segments.src: Functional documentation — statements from treating physicians about limitations, frequency of flare-ups, or inability to sustain regular hours — may carry more weight under the new standards than a diagnosis alone.
segments.tr: Dokumentasi fungsional — pernyataan dari dokter yang merawat tentang keterbatasan, frekuensi kambuh, atau ketidakmampuan untuk mempertahankan jam kerja teratur — dapat memiliki bobot lebih besar di bawah standar baru daripada sekadar diagnosis.

segments.src: State Medicaid websites and enrollment hotlines remain the most reliable source for current, state-specific exemption criteria, since implementation timelines and documentation requirements differ significantly depending on where the litigation and rulemaking process currently stands.
segments.tr: Situs web Medicaid negara bagian dan saluran siaga pendaftaran tetap menjadi sumber paling andal untuk kriteria pembebasan spesifik negara bagian saat ini, karena tenggat waktu pelaksanaan dan persyaratan dokumentasi berbeda secara signifikan tergantung di mana proses peradilan dan pembuatan aturan saat ini berdiri.

segments.src: Because this is an evolving legal and administrative situation, enrollees and providers should treat any specific requirement as subject to change until courts and CMS finalize guidance.
segments.tr: Karena ini adalah situasi hukum dan administratif yang terus berkembang, peserta dan penyedia layanan harus menganggap persyarat spesifik apa pun dapat berubah sampai pengadilan dan CMS memfinalisasi panduan.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Gambaran Yang Lebih Besar

segments.src: This dispute is really about who bears the burden of proof in a safety-net program undergoing structural change.
segments.tr: Perselisihan ini sebenarnya adalah tentang siapa yang menanggung beban pembuktian dalam program jaring pengaman yang mengalami perubahan struktural.

segments.src: As work requirements roll out nationally, the exemption question will likely serve as an early test case for how flexible — or how rigid — the new system becomes in practice.
segments.tr: Saat persyaratan kerja diluncurkan secara nasional, pertanyaan pembebasan kemungkinan akan berfungsi sebagai kasus uji awal seberapa fleksibel — atau seberapa kaku — sistem baru ini pada praktiknya.

segments.src: Whatever the courts and CMS ultimately decide, the outcome will shape not just paperwork, but whether people with real, if hard-to-categorize, health limitations retain access to coverage they depend on.
segments.tr: Apa pun yang akhirnya diputuskan oleh pengadilan dan CMS, hasilnya akan membentuk tidak hanya urusan berkas, tetapi juga apakah orang dengan keterbatasan kesehatan yang nyata, meskipun sulit dikategorikan, tetap mempertahankan akses ke cakupan yang mereka andalkan.

segments.src: ## A New Rule, an Old Problem

segments.src: Medicaid work requirements are no longer a hypothetical policy debate — they are becoming an administrative reality that state agencies must implement, often with limited guidance and even less time.

segments.src: For years, states that wanted to test work requirements assumed that a documented medical diagnosis — a chronic illness, a mental health condition, a disability determination — would be enough to exempt someone from mandatory work-hour reporting.

segments.src: ## Why the Distinction Matters
segments.tr: ## なぜこの違いが重要なのか

segments.src: The practical gap between "diagnosed" and "disabled enough to be exempt" is where the real-world impact lands.
segments.tr: 「診断された」ことと「免除されるほど障害がある」ことの間の実務的な隔たりこそが、現実に影響を及ぼす部分です。

segments.src: Someone managing a serious but episodic illness — certain autoimmune conditions, recurring mental health crises, chronic pain disorders — may be unable to reliably hold a job on a fixed schedule, yet may not meet a strict clinical threshold for a formal exemption.
